# <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>David Akesson</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <style>
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
    :root{
      --green:#1a3a2a;--green-mid:#2c5f42;--gold:#d4a017;
      --gold-light:#f0c84a;--cream:#f5f0e8;--dark:#0e1f16;
      --text:#1c1c1c;--muted:#5a6b5e;
    }
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
    body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--text);overflow-x:hidden;}

    nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 48px;height:64px;background:rgba(14,31,22,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.3);}
    .nav-logo{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.05em;text-decoration:none;}
    .nav-links{display:flex;gap:32px;list-style:none;}
    .nav-links a{color:rgba(245,240,232,.8);text-decoration:none;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .2s;}
    .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--gold);}

    #home{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding-top:64px;}
    .hero-left{background:var(--green);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:80px 56px 80px 72px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
    .hero-left::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-80px;right:-40px;width:6px;height:160%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold) 0%,var(--gold-light) 50%,var(--gold) 100%);transform:rotate(12deg);transform-origin:top center;opacity:.6;}
    .hero-eyebrow{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px;}
    .hero-name{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,5vw,4.2rem);font-weight:900;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:24px;}
    .hero-tagline{font-size:1rem;color:rgba(245,240,232,.7);line-height:1.7;max-width:400px;margin-bottom:32px;}
    .hero-flags{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:32px;}
    .flag-img{width:36px;height:22px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:3px;}
    .flag-label{font-size:.75rem;color:rgba(245,240,232,.55);letter-spacing:.05em;}
    .hero-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--gold);color:var(--dark);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 28px;transition:background .2s,transform .2s;width:fit-content;}
    .hero-cta:hover{background:var(--gold-light);transform:translateX(4px);}
    .hero-right{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--dark);}
    .hero-right img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;opacity:.85;display:block;}
    .hero-right::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--green) 0%,transparent 30%);}

    section{padding:100px 72px;}
    .section-label{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:12px;}
    .section-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.5vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--green);line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:48px;}
    .divider{width:48px;height:3px;background:var(--gold);margin-bottom:48px;}

    #about{background:var(--green);color:var(--cream);padding:80px 72px;}
    #about .section-title{color:var(--cream);}
    .about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start;}
    .about-text p{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.85;color:rgba(245,240,232,.85);}
    .about-text p+p{margin-top:20px;}
    .about-sidebar{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px;}
    .info-block h4{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px;}
    .info-block p,.info-block li{font-size:.92rem;color:rgba(245,240,232,.75);line-height:1.6;}
    .info-block ul{list-style:none;}
    .info-block li::before{content:'— ';color:var(--gold);}

    .teak-strip{background:var(--cream);padding:48px 72px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:40px;border-top:3px solid var(--gold);border-bottom:3px solid var(--gold);}
    .teak-strip img{width:80px;height:auto;object-fit:contain;}
    .teak-text h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:6px;}
    .teak-text p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;max-width:600px;}

    #resume{background:var(--cream);}
    .resume-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;}
    .resume-col h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--green);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding-left:14px;margin-bottom:28px;}
    .resume-item{margin-bottom:28px;padding-left:17px;border-left:1px solid rgba(26,58,42,.15);}
    .resume-item h4{font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:4px;}
    .resume-item .meta{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;}
    .resume-item p,.resume-item li{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;}
    .resume-item ul{list-style:none;}
    .resume-item li::before{content:'· ';color:var(--gold);font-weight:bold;}

    #skills{background:var(--dark);color:var(--cream);}
    #skills .section-title{color:var(--cream);}
    .skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;}
    .skill-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.2);padding:32px 28px;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s;}
    .skill-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);}
    .skill-card .card-icon{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:16px;}
    .skill-card h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px;}
    .skill-card ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
    .skill-card li{font-size:.88rem;color:rgba(245,240,232,.7);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
    .skill-card li::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}

    #contact{background:var(--green);padding:80px 72px;}
    .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;}
    .contact-text p{font-size:1.05rem;color:rgba(245,240,232,.75);line-height:1.8;}
    .contact-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-decoration:none;padding:18px 24px;border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.3);margin-bottom:16px;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;}
    .contact-link:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(212,160,23,.08);}
    .contact-link .cl-icon{font-size:1.4rem;}
    .contact-link .cl-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:3px;}
    .contact-link .cl-value{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--cream);}

    footer{background:var(--dark);border-top:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.3);padding:32px 72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
    footer .logo{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;}
    footer p{font-size:.8rem;color:rgba(245,240,232,.4);}

    .fade-in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease;}
    .fade-in.visible{opacity:1;transform:none;}

    @media(max-width:900px){
      nav{padding:0 20px;} .nav-links{gap:16px;} .nav-links a{font-size:.72rem;}
      #home{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:auto;}
      .hero-left{padding:80px 28px 60px;}
      .hero-right{height:60vw;}
      section,#about,#contact{padding:60px 28px;}
      .teak-strip{padding:36px 28px;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
      .about-grid,.resume-grid,.skills-grid,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px;}
      footer{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:24px 28px;text-align:center;}
    }
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
      *,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;}
      html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <nav>
    <a href="#home" class="nav-logo">David Akesson</a>
    <ul class="nav-links">
      <li><a href="#home">Home</a></li>
      <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
      <li><a href="#resume">Resume</a></li>
      <li><a href="#skills">Skills</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section id="home">
    <div class="hero-left">
      <p class="hero-eyebrow">New York City &middot; 10th Grade</p>
      <h1 class="hero-name">David<br>Akesson</h1>
      <p class="hero-tagline">Student, athlete, and TEAK Fellow at The Browning School &mdash; driven by science, shaped by sport, and rooted in two cultures.</p>
      <div class="hero-flags">
        <img class="flag-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Ghana flag"/>
        <span class="flag-label">Ghanaian&ndash;American &middot; Ga &amp; English</span>
      </div>
      <a href="#about" class="hero-cta">Learn More &rarr;</a>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-right">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="David Akesson running through a tunnel of teammates"/>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ABOUT -->
  <section id="about">
    <div class="fade-in">
      <p class="section-label">Who I Am</p>
      <h2 class="section-title">About Me</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="about-grid fade-in">
      <div class="about-text">
        <p>My name is David Akesson, and I am a 10th grade student at The Browning School in New York City. I am passionate about science, athletics, and giving back to my community. As a TEAK Fellow since 2022, I have had the opportunity to push myself academically and develop leadership skills that carry into everything I do &mdash; from captaining sports teams to editing newsletters.</p>
        <p>Outside the classroom, I compete on the soccer and basketball teams, and I am always looking for opportunities to grow, collaborate, and make an impact. My goal is to pursue a college education in a STEM-related field, where I can combine my curiosity for science with real-world problem solving.</p>
        <p>I was born into a Ghanaian family and speak Ga fluently alongside English. That dual identity &mdash; New York City kid and proud son of Ghana &mdash; shapes how I see the world and how I show up for my community.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="about-sidebar">
        <div class="info-block">
          <h4>School</h4>
          <p>The Browning School, New York City<br>Expected Graduation: June 2027</p>
        </div>
        <div class="info-block">
          <h4>Athletics</h4>
          <ul>
            <li>JV Soccer Captain</li>
            <li>Varsity Soccer</li>
            <li>JV Basketball Captain</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="info-block">
          <h4>Interests</h4>
          <ul>
            <li>Biology &amp; STEM Research</li>
            <li>Computer Science</li>
            <li>Community Leadership</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="info-block">
          <h4>Languages</h4>
          <p>English &middot; Ga (fluent)</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- TEAK STRIP -->
  <div class="teak-strip fade-in">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="TEAK Fellowship logo"/>
    <div class="teak-text">
      <h3>TEAK Fellowship &mdash; 20th Cohort</h3>
      <p>Member since 6th grade. TEAK has challenged me through rigorous summer institutes and afterschool enrichment, building the academic and leadership foundation I bring to everything I do.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- RESUME -->
  <section id="resume">
    <div class="fade-in">
      <p class="section-label">Background</p>
      <h2 class="section-title">Resume</h2>
      <div class="divider"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="resume-grid fade-in">
      <div class="resume-col">
        <h3>Education &amp; Programs</h3>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>The Browning School</h4>
          <p class="meta">New York City &middot; Expected June 2027</p>
          <p>College-preparatory school in Manhattan. Coursework includes Biology, Chemistry, Latin III, Pre-Calculus, and Computer Science.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>TEAK Fellowship</h4>
          <p class="meta">Member since 2022 &middot; 20th Cohort</p>
          <p>Rigorous academic enrichment program. Summer institutes, leadership development, and college access support.</p>
        </div>
        <h3 style="margin-top:40px;">Leadership &amp; Activities</h3>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>BSU &mdash; Black Student Union</h4>
          <p class="meta">Member &amp; Newsletter Editor</p>
          <p>Co-produce a monthly newsletter featuring community shoutouts and school highlights.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>BSC &mdash; Black Student Coalition</h4>
          <p class="meta">Member</p>
          <p>Participate in networking events, college tours, and community-building initiatives.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="resume-col">
        <h3>Athletics</h3>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>JV Basketball Captain</h4>
          <p class="meta">The Browning School</p>
          <p>Led the team to an 11&ndash;9 record &mdash; the best JV season in recent school history.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>JV Soccer Captain</h4>
          <p class="meta">The Browning School</p>
          <p>Captained one of the most successful recent JV soccer seasons at Browning.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>Varsity Soccer</h4>
          <p class="meta">The Browning School</p>
          <p>Promoted from JV to varsity &mdash; recognition of consistent performance and leadership on the pitch.</p>
        </div>
        <h3 style="margin-top:40px;">Projects</h3>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>Biology Bahamas Research</h4>
          <p class="meta">Field Research Project</p>
          <p>Investigated the relationship between coral health, water depth, and shore distance. Collected and analyzed field data.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="resume-item">
          <h4>Student Council Campaign</h4>
          <p class="meta">Instagram Campaign &middot; 2025</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Ran for class representative</li>
            <li>Built an Instagram campaign from scratch</li>
            <li>47 followers, 1.5k post views</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- SKILLS -->
  <section id="skills">
    <div class="fade-in">
      <p class="section-label">What I Bring</p>
      <h2 class="section-title">Skills</h2>
      <div class="divider"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="skills-grid fade-in">
      <div class="skill-card">
        <div class="card-icon">&#128187;</div>
        <h3>Technical</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Python (Intro CS)</li>
          <li>GitHub &amp; version control</li>
          <li>Data collection &amp; analysis</li>
          <li>Basic HTML/CSS</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <div class="card-icon">&#128218;</div>
        <h3>Academic</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Biology &amp; Chemistry</li>
          <li>History &amp; Social Studies</li>
          <li>Latin III</li>
          <li>Pre-Calculus</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <div class="card-icon">&#129309;</div>
        <h3>Leadership</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Team captaincy</li>
          <li>Communication</li>
          <li>Community organizing</li>
          <li>Newsletter editing</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <div class="card-icon">&#127757;</div>
        <h3>Languages</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>English (native)</li>
          <li>Ga (fluent)</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <div class="card-icon">&#9917;</div>
        <h3>Athletics</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Soccer (JV Captain + Varsity)</li>
          <li>Basketball (JV Captain)</li>
          <li>Track &amp; Field</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <div class="card-icon">&#128300;</div>
        <h3>Research</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Field data collection</li>
          <li>Scientific writing</li>
          <li>Lab technique</li>
          <li>Environmental biology</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- CONTACT -->
  <section id="contact">
    <div class="fade-in">
      <p class="section-label" style="color:var(--gold);">Get In Touch</p>
      <h2 class="section-title" style="color:var(--cream);">Contact</h2>
      <div class="divider"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="contact-grid fade-in">
      <div class="contact-text">
        <p>Feel free to reach out &mdash; whether it&rsquo;s about academics, athletics, community work, or anything else. I&rsquo;m always open to connecting.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <a href="mailto:dakesson@gmail.com" class="contact-link">
          <span class="cl-icon">&#9993;&#65039;</span>
          <div>
            <p class="cl-label">Email</p>
            <p class="cl-value">dakesson@gmail.com</p>
          </div>
        </a>
        <a href="tel:+13475004224" class="contact-link">
          <span class="cl-icon">&#128222;</span>
          <div>
            <p class="cl-label">Phone</p>
            <p class="cl-value">(347) 500-4224</p>
          </div>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    <span class="logo">David Akesson</span>
    <p>The Browning School &middot; TEAK Fellow &middot; New York City</p>
    <p>&copy; 2026</p>
  </footer>

  <script>
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(e => { if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible'); });
    }, {threshold:0.1});
    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
  </script>
</body>
</html>
